title.zh: 复盘：必需部分和可选乐趣都看见了吗

paragraphs.zh: 回到六人聚会的大横幅，分开写“来的人需要知道什么”和“大家喜欢一起做什么”。小标牌可能够传信息，大横幅也可能就是这次乐趣，两者不必争唯一正确。可以只画两版。复盘关注自己提出的缩减是否听懂了活动目的，自己的时间限制是否也说清；不把省事自动当成熟，也不用大制作证明热情。
paragraphs.en: For the huge banner at a six-person gathering, separate information visitors need from something people enjoy making together. A small sign may convey the information while the banner is itself the fun. Neither must be uniquely right. Sketch both. Review the purpose behind a proposed reduction and your time limits without treating less effort as maturity or a large production as proof of enthusiasm.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果六个人的聚会想做一条巨大横幅，你会怎样同时照顾实际信息和大家想一起制作的乐趣？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If six people wanted a huge banner for their gathering, how would you consider both useful information and the pleasure of making it together?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：一致的约定还能共同修改吗
title.en: Review room to revise a consistent agreement

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两种游戏解释，先各写一句理解，再找这轮开始前需要约清的差异。若有人需要多一点时间，先问原因是否影响参与，再共同改规则；一致不等于永不调整。可以只讨论虚构玩法。复盘关注约定是否明白、修改是否得到同意，不把谁说服谁当成伦理输赢，也不把自己偏好的规则变成管别人选择的权利。
paragraphs.en: For two readings of a game instruction, write each interpretation and identify what must be agreed before the round. If someone needs more time, discuss participation and revise together; consistency need not mean never changing. Use a fictional game. Review understanding and agreement rather than ethical victory, and do not turn a preferred rule into control over others’ choices.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同一句游戏说明有两种理解，你会怎样在下一轮前约清，又为合理修改留下什么办法？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a game instruction had two interpretations, how would you agree before the next round and leave room for a useful revision?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：偏好说清之后，是否真的留了空位
title.en: Review the space left after stating a preference

paragraphs.zh: 回到手工主题的一分钟提议，把想要的版本和一个理由说完，再设想别人选另一版。你可以问清安排，也可以决定是否参加，不必重复推介来证明自己有立场。只起草两句话即可。复盘看偏好是否被理解、另一提议是否有实际空间，而非是否成功如愿；拒绝不证明谁愚蠢、不忠或较不在乎。
paragraphs.en: For the one-minute craft-theme pitch, state a version and a reason, then imagine another choice winning. Clarify the plan or decide whether to join without repeating the pitch to prove conviction. Draft two sentences. Review a clear preference and genuine space for another proposal rather than getting your way. Refusal establishes no foolishness, disloyalty or lack of care.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只能用一分钟提议一个手工主题，你会怎样说清偏好，再给完全不同的建议留一个真实机会？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With one minute to suggest a craft theme, how would you state a preference and leave a genuine opportunity for a different suggestion?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：解开一个小障碍，不必接下全部
title.en: Review one obstacle without taking over everything

paragraphs.zh: 沿用缺少材料的例子，先写自己愿意处理的一件事，再写完成后由谁接下一步。若替代物还需别人确认，就把未知说出来，不默默包办。可以只改一张虚构分工卡。复盘看帮助是否针对障碍、范围是否现实、自己是否还能参与活动，不用低调程度、跑了多少趟或有没有被感谢证明贡献。
paragraphs.en: For the missing material, name one action you would offer and who handles the next step afterward. State uncertainty if a substitute needs another person’s approval instead of quietly taking over. Revise a fictional task card. Review the obstacle, a realistic scope and room to join the activity, without proving contribution through silence, errands or thanks.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果活动只差一件材料就能开始，你会提供哪一小步帮助，又怎样说清下一步由谁接手？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If one missing material delayed an activity, which small action would you offer and how would you clarify the next handover?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：好玩之外，也有直白入口吗
title.en: Review a plain entrance alongside playful participation

paragraphs.zh: 回到两分钟试玩，分别想象想试、只看和想直接读说明的人。给每种都留一个入口，再用一句普通话说明下一步；没有接住玩笑，也应知道怎么玩。可以只构思示例，不必组织活动。复盘关注参与方式是否真可选择，不要求现场都开心，也不以是否敢拒绝来测性格；友好同样包括自己可以跳过。
paragraphs.en: For the two-minute trial, imagine trying, watching or reading plain instructions. Offer each an entrance and state the next action plainly, so missing the joke does not hide how to play. Imagine an example without hosting. Review usable choices without requiring universal cheerfulness or testing personality through refusal. Friendliness includes your option to skip too.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果要给新游戏做两分钟趣味示范，你会怎样照顾想试、只看和更喜欢文字说明的人？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a two-minute playful game demonstration, how would you include someone wanting to try, watch or read instructions?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：确认意愿不必变成公开表态
title.en: Review willingness without requiring a public declaration

paragraphs.zh: 沿用惊喜聚光灯的例子，先分清当事人是否想要关注、想要哪种形式，以及是否希望这件事保持私下。可以只设想问法，不必联系任何人。安静不是隐藏需要的证据，接受或谢绝也不需要解释。复盘关注选择有没有可用的替代和退出方式，不根据加入人数评共情，也不替当事人决定怎样才舒服。
paragraphs.en: For the surprise spotlight, distinguish whether attention is wanted, which form fits and whether the discussion should stay private. Imagine wording without contacting anyone. Quietness proves no hidden need, and accepting or declining requires no explanation. Review usable alternatives and an exit without grading empathy through attendance or deciding comfort on someone else’s behalf.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果有人提议给朋友一个公开惊喜，你会怎样先问意愿，并准备一个安静版本或取消的选择？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If someone proposed a public surprise for a friend, how would you ask first and offer a quiet version or cancellation?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：想象的大场面与实际承诺分开
title.en: Review a grand imagined scene separately from commitments

paragraphs.zh: 回到虚构吉祥物，给它一个夸张出场，再只保留一个几分钟能想完的小细节。两版可以都停留在故事里，不必采购、制作或把任务分给别人。复盘看缩小以后还有哪一点有趣，以及哪些从未被同意要做；大家不想继续也能让点子好好结束，不把“想得大”当胆量、创造力或创业能力的分数。
paragraphs.en: For the imaginary mascot, invent an oversized entrance and retain one detail that takes minutes to imagine. Both can remain stories without purchases, production or tasks for others. Review the enjoyable detail and what was never agreed. An unwanted continuation can end gracefully; a big imagined scene measures neither courage, creativity nor entrepreneurial ability.

title.en: Discuss choices through a fictional activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果虚构吉祥物要有一个超大出场，你最想编什么，再怎样缩成一个随时能结束的小玩笑？”各提一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度改一版。可以只想象，不必参加真实活动或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an imaginary mascot’s oversized entrance, what would you invent and how would you shrink it to an easily ended joke?” Suggest an action each, then revise it through another character angle. Imagine without joining a real activity or imitating the story.
